company.name: Insurf
company.shortDescription: Insurf provides AI-based tools for managing prior authorizations, denial appeals, and health plan cost modeling.
company.description: Insurf develops AI-based tools that support coverage decisions in health insurance. The company offers Inveto, a denial-management workbench that prepares source-cited prior authorization requests and appeal packets, coordinates physician attestation, and tracks payer responses and outcomes. Inveto structures a six-step workflow from intake through drafting, physician review, staff-controlled submission, follow-up, and outcome reporting. Insurf also offers Surely, a cost engine that models the potential twelve-month cost of health plans using premiums, deductibles, drug tiers, networks, and out-of-pocket limits. Surely accepts household and care needs through a plain-language intake and translates them into structured plan assumptions. Insurf focuses on practices, brokers, employers, and diligence teams evaluating coverage and plan options.
